note: Complete public scientific-checker bank. Inactive unless SCIBENCH_TRIGGER_LOG is set.

checkers.invariant: `rho_crit(z) / E(z)^2 = 3 H0^2/(8 pi G)`, which the repository tabulates as `rho_crit_g_cm3_h2 * h^2` (`utilities/physical_ratios.py`)
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), any `z` with `E(z) > 0`, `H0 = h * 100 km/s/Mpc`
checkers.rationale: every overdensity field divides by this.

checkers.invariant: `D_H = 299792.458 km/s / H0` in Mpc (c is a defined constant)
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine)
checkers.rationale: all comoving distances scale with `D_H`.

checkers.alarm: `|lookback - (t(z_i) - t(z_f))| > 5e-5 * t(z_i)` (model error: log-table linear interpolation at 1000 bins/dex ~ 1e-6, cumulative trapezoid ~ 4e-7, log-spaced trapezoid ~ 4e-8)
checkers.invariant: `lookback_time(z_i, z_f) = t_from_z(z_i) - t_from_z(z_f)` (two independent routes to the same elapsed time: quadrature in redshift vs the tabulated age integral)
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `1e-3 <= 1/(1+z_f)`, `z_f <= 1e3`, `use_dark_factor` any
checkers.rationale: both quantities are published as elapsed cosmic time.

checkers.invariant: `t_from_a(a_from_t(t)) = t`
checkers.precondition: `E(z)^2 >= 1e-4` on `z in [0, 99]` (near-loitering models exceed the age table's resolution); a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `a` in `[1e-2, 10]`
checkers.rationale: the two functions are documented as inverse maps between time and expansion.
checkers.scientific_quantity: scale factor at a given cosmic time

checkers.invariant: `t(a) = 2/(3 H0 sqrt(OL)) asinh(sqrt(OL/Om) a^{3/2})`
checkers.precondition: `omega_radiation = 0`, `omega_curvature = 0`, `use_dark_factor = False`, `omega_matter, omega_lambda >= 0.05`, `|Om + OL - 1| < 1e-9`, `a` in `[1e-2, 10]` (the table starts at `a = 1e-6`, truncation `~6.7e-10/sqrt(Om) H0^-1` negligible for this `a`)
checkers.rationale: an analytic result for the age exists for exactly this family.

checkers.alarm: ordering violated by more than `C eps D_C`
checkers.invariant: open (`Ok > 0`) `D_M >= D_C`; closed (`Ok < 0`) `D_M <= D_C`; flat `D_M = D_C` (`sinh x >= x >= sin x`)
checkers.precondition: scalar redshifts (documented as floats); a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `z_i < z_f`
checkers.rationale: curvature sign defines which geometry the model is in.

checkers.alarm: `|d_A - d_A12| > 4e-4 (|term_1| + |term_2|)/(1+z_f)` (the tolerance floor 4/bins, bins = 10000, absorbs the first-order error of yt's `trapezoid_int`, ~1e-4; precision-level quadrature error is not a target)
checkers.invariant: `d_A12 = [D_M2 sqrt(1 + Ok D_M1^2/D_H^2) - D_M1 sqrt(1 + Ok D_M2^2/D_H^2)]/(1+z_f)` with `D_M1, D_M2` the transverse comoving distances from `z=0` to `z_i, z_f` evaluated by the checker's own quadrature of `1/E(z)` (flat: `(chi_f - chi_i)/(1+z_f)`)
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `0 <= z_i < z_f`
checkers.rationale: the lens/source geometry of weak lensing uses exactly this.

checkers.alarm: `|d_L - r^2 d_A| > 1e-9 (D_M(z_f)(1+z_f) + D_M(z_i)(1+z_i))` with `D_M` from the same API (round-off of two sums over the same quadrature)
checkers.invariant: `d_L(z_i, z_f) = ((1+z_f)/(1+z_i))^2 d_A(z_i, z_f)` (Etherington reciprocity for an observer at `z_i`)
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `0 <= z_i < z_f`
checkers.rationale: the same physical pair of redshifts must give consistent flux and size distances.

checkers.alarm: relative difference `> 1.2e-3` (tolerance floor 12/bins, bins = 10000: V ~ D_C^3 triples the ~1e-4 first-order error of yt's `trapezoid_int`; precision-level quadrature error is not a target)
checkers.invariant: `V_C(z_i, z_f) = 4 pi D_H int D_M(z)^2/E(z) dz` (Hogg eq. 28, full sky), evaluated with the checker's own nested quadrature
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `0 <= z_i < z_f <= 20`
checkers.rationale: number-density estimates in cosmological volumes use it.

checkers.invariant: `V(z_i,z_m) + V(z_m,z_f) = V(z_i,z_f)`
checkers.precondition: a Cosmology with finite density parameters, omega_matter > 0 and E(z)^2 > 0 on the interval (closed models: sqrt(|Omega_k|) D_C/D_H < pi/2, the first branch of the sine), `z_i < z_m < z_f <= 20` with `z_m` the geometric midpoint of `1+z`
checkers.rationale: volume is a measure on redshift space; the `k = 0` end of the split is the empty interval.

checkers.alarm: relative error `> max(1e-9, 16 eps)` (eps of the redshift dtype; 1e-9 for float64)
checkers.invariant: for `w(a) = w_0 + w_a(1-a)`, `rho_DE(a)/rho_DE(1) = exp(3 int_a^1 (1+w(a'))/a' da')`, evaluated by Gauss-Legendre
checkers.rationale: the docstring defines the parameterization; the factor must follow from continuity of dark-energy density.

checkers.alarm: relative mismatch `> 1e-5` (the three constants come from different CODATA editions: <= 2e-6)
checkers.invariant: `sigma_T = (8 pi/3) (e^2/(m_e c^2))^2` with `e, m_e, c` taken from the same `ds.units.physical_constants`
checkers.precondition: a dataset with `El_number_density`
checkers.rationale: three stored constants and one derived constant describe the same physics.

checkers.precondition: temperature field finite
checkers.rationale: X-ray and plasma fields convert between K and keV.

checkers.invariant: `RM = e^3/(2 pi m_e^2 c^4) int n_e B_par dl`; with CODATA-2018 `e, m_e, c, pc` the coefficient is 0.8120 rad m^-2 per (cm^-3 uG pc). The checker evaluates `n_e`, `B_par` in those units and applies its own constants
checkers.precondition: unit system gaussian-cgs or SI, field `rotation_measure` evaluable
checkers.rationale: Faraday rotation analyses compare directly to the astrophysical coefficient.

checkers.alarm: outside the bracket (slack 1e-3) or ordering violated
checkers.invariant: with accepted atomic weights `A_H = 1.00794`, `A_He = 4.002602` (+/-1e-3): fully ionized `mu in [A_H/2, A_He/3]`, neutral `mu in [A_H, A_He]`, and `mu_ionized < mu_neutral`
checkers.precondition: `ion_state` in `{"ionized", "neutral", None}` with the repository's primordial H/He fractions
checkers.rationale: any H-He mixture has a mean particle mass between its end-members.

checkers.invariant: `sum_E count_E(species) * A_E = weight(species)`, with `count_E` from the nucleus-counting parser used for nuclei densities and `A_E` from the periodic table (two independent parsers of one formula string)
checkers.observation_point: inside `_nuclei_density` for every species of the dataset
checkers.precondition: species names accepted by `ChemicalFormula` (element symbols with counts, optional `_p<n>`/`_m<n>` ion suffix)
checkers.rationale: nuclei densities rely on mass being conserved between a molecule and its atoms.

checkers.alarm: outside the interval by more than `C eps dt`
checkers.invariant: with `d = min(dx, dy, dz)` and `|v| = sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2 + vz^2)` (raw velocity): `d/(c_s + |v|) <= dt <= d/c_s` (the fastest axial signal speed is between `c_s` and `c_s + |v|`)
checkers.precondition: Cartesian geometry, `c_s > 0` finite, `dx, dy, dz > 0`
checkers.rationale: the time step must resolve the fastest signal in the cell.

checkers.invariant: `v_A = B_T / sqrt(mu_0 rho_SI)` (CODATA-2018 `mu_0`), computed by converting `B` to tesla (`1 G = 1e-4 T`) and `rho` to kg m^-3
checkers.precondition: gaussian-cgs or SI magnetic field, no `_magnetic_factor` override, `rho > 0`
checkers.rationale: the cgs normalization (4 pi) and the SI normalization (`mu_0`) describe the same physical speed.

checkers.invariant: `u_B = B_T^2/(2 mu_0)` in J m^-3, converted to the field's pressure units
checkers.precondition: as FLD-003
checkers.rationale: magnetic pressure/plasma beta are built on it.

checkers.alarm: `|u_t^2 - |u|^2 - c^2| > C eps gamma^2 c^2` (cancellation of two terms of size `gamma^2 c^2`)
checkers.invariant: `(gamma c)^2 - |gamma v|^2 = c^2`
checkers.rationale: relativistic invariant.

checkers.invariant: `overdensity = matter_overdensity * Omega_m(z)`, `Omega_m(z) = Om (1+z)^3 / E(z)^2` (same matter density, two normalizations)
checkers.precondition: cosmological dataset whose `ds.cosmology` densities equal `ds.omega_*`
checkers.rationale: halo and clustering analyses switch between the two.

checkers.alarm: `|r cos(theta) - z| > C eps r/ sin(theta)` or `|r sin(theta) - R| > C eps r / sin(theta)`
checkers.invariant: `z = r cos(theta)` and `R = r sin(theta)`, where `r=get_sph_r`, `theta=get_sph_theta`, `R=get_cyl_r`, `z=get_cyl_z` (same normal)
checkers.precondition: coordinate and normal magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; `|coords| > 0`, `sin(theta) >= 1e-4`, nonzero `normal` whose nonzero components differ by at most `1e100`
checkers.rationale: they are two coordinate descriptions of one point.

checkers.invariant: rotating coordinates by `alpha` right-handed about `normal` leaves `r, theta, R, z` unchanged and shifts `phi` by `+alpha` (mod `2 pi`); the rotation is the checker's own Rodrigues rotation (exact to eps)
checkers.precondition: coordinate and normal magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; `R/r >= 1e-4`, nonzero `normal` whose nonzero components differ by at most `1e100`
checkers.rationale: the azimuth is the angle about the normal.

checkers.invariant: `v_R^2 + v_theta^2 + v_z^2 = |v|^2` (orthonormal basis)
checkers.observation_point: return of each of `get_cyl_{r,theta,z}_component` (checker re-calls the other two)
checkers.precondition: vector and normal magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; nonzero `normal` (components within `1e100`), finite vectors, any `theta`
checkers.rationale: components in an orthonormal basis conserve the norm.

checkers.invariant: `v_r^2 + v_theta^2 + v_phi^2 = |v|^2` (orthonormal basis)
checkers.observation_point: return of each of `get_sph_{r,theta,phi}_component` (checker re-calls the other two)
checkers.precondition: vector and normal magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; nonzero `normal` (components within `1e100`), finite vectors, any `theta, phi`
checkers.rationale: components in an orthonormal basis conserve the norm.

checkers.invariant: `d <= euclidean(a,b)`, `d <= sqrt(sum_periodic (L_i/2)^2 + sum_nonperiodic L_i^2)` and `d(a,b) = d(b,a)`
checkers.precondition: floating-point or signed-integer coordinates (unsigned subtraction wraps); `|a_i - b_i| <= L_i` per axis
checkers.rationale: the minimum-image convention bounds distances by half the box.

checkers.alarm: outside `[LE - s, RE + s]` or non-integer by more than `s/width`, `s = C eps (|pos| + width)`
checkers.invariant: `LE <= x' < RE` and `(pos - x')/width` is an integer, per axis
checkers.precondition: finite `pos`
checkers.rationale: periodic boundary conditions identify points differing by a box width.
checkers.scientific_quantity: position wrapped into a periodic domain

checkers.invariant: `index/radius = index/spherical_radius`, each the (minimum-image) distance of the cell to `center`
checkers.precondition: cell data, `center` field parameter set, non-spectral geometry, periodicity any
checkers.rationale: profiles and selections use either interchangeably.

checkers.alarm: relative error `> C eps (1 + r/dr + 1/(dtheta |sin theta|))` (cancellation in the exact difference)
checkers.invariant: `V = int r^2 sin(theta) dr dtheta dphi` over the cell, by the checker's Gauss-Legendre rule (3 x 10 x 1 nodes)
checkers.observation_point: return of the spherical `cell_volume` field function
checkers.precondition: cell `r > 0`, `dr, dtheta, dphi >= 0`
checkers.rationale: every mass and energy sum weights cells by this volume.

checkers.alarm: relative error `> C eps (1 + r/dr)` (cancellation in the exact difference)
checkers.invariant: `V = int r dr dtheta dz` over the cell, by the checker's Gauss-Legendre rule (3 nodes in `r`)
checkers.observation_point: return of the cylindrical `cell_volume` field function
checkers.precondition: cell `r > 0`, `dr, dtheta, dz >= 0`
checkers.rationale: every mass and energy sum weights cells by this volume.

checkers.alarm: relative error `> C eps (1 + r/dr + 1/(dtheta |sin theta|))`
checkers.invariant: `V = int r^2 sin(theta) dr dtheta dphi` over the cell, by the checker's Gauss-Legendre rule (3 x 10 nodes)
checkers.observation_point: return of the geographic `cell_volume` field function
checkers.precondition: cell `r > 0`, `dr, dtheta, dphi >= 0` (`r` from altitude + surface height, `theta` from latitude, `phi` from longitude)
checkers.rationale: as GEO-008 for the geographic handler.

checkers.invariant: `R^T R = I`, `det R = 1`, `R a = a`
checkers.precondition: unit `rot_vector` (norm within 1e-12), finite `theta`
checkers.rationale: rotations preserve lengths and orientation and fix their axis.

checkers.invariant: `|R a| = |a|` and the `dim` component is unchanged
checkers.precondition: vector magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; finite `Nx3` vectors, `dim in {0,1,2}`
checkers.rationale: `rotate_vector_3D` preserves length and the axial component.

checkers.invariant: `quaternion_to_rotation_matrix(q)` is proper orthogonal and `rotation_matrix_to_quaternion` of it returns `+/- q` (double cover); conversely a quaternion from a rotation matrix is unit and reproduces the matrix
checkers.precondition: unit quaternion (norm within 1e-12) or proper-orthogonal matrix (within 1e-12)
checkers.rationale: Quaternion and matrix representations are mutually consistent.

checkers.alarm: rigidity `> C eps (|P-CoM|, |V|)`; alignment `> max(1e-6, 2 sqrt(eps)) |L|` with eps of the dtype of `L` (the angles are obtained with `arccos`, whose conditioning near 0 and pi is ~`sqrt(eps)`; P/T)
checkers.invariant: `|P_out| = |P - CoM|` and `|V_out| = |V|` per datum (rigid), `(P_out x V_out) . L_out = ((P - CoM) x V) . L` (orientation preserving; the unit-aware difference `P - CoM` is used), and `L_out = |L| z-hat`
checkers.precondition: magnitudes of `L`, positions and velocities in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; `L` finite nonzero, finite `P`, `V`
checkers.rationale: `modify_reference_frame` is a rigid change of frame that aligns `L` with `z`.

checkers.invariant: `(e1, e2, e3)` are unit, pairwise orthogonal, `e1` parallel to the input, `e3 = e1 x e2`
checkers.precondition: magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; nonzero 3-vector whose nonzero components differ by at most `1e100`
checkers.rationale: `ortho_find` returns a right-handed orthonormal triad.

checkers.invariant: `|V|^2 = v_rot^2 + v_rad^2 + v_par^2` (azimuthal, cylindrical-radial, axial)
checkers.precondition: magnitudes of positions, velocities and `L` in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; data with cylindrical radius `> 1e-9` of the largest `|P - CoM|`, finite `L != 0`
checkers.rationale: Velocity decomposition around the angular-momentum axis is orthogonal.
checkers.scientific_quantity: velocity decomposition about the angular momentum axis

checkers.invariant: rows `(east, north, normal)` are orthonormal with `det = +1`, `normal` parallel to the input normal, and `north` in the plane perpendicular to it
checkers.precondition: normal and north vectors with magnitudes in `[1e-100, 1e100]`; nonzero normal; if a north vector is given, `sin(angle(north, normal)) >= 1e-6`
checkers.rationale: Camera orientation basis is orthonormal and right-handed.

checkers.alarm: outside by more than `n eps max|x|`
checkers.invariant: each coordinate of the weighted mean position is within the extrema of the contributing positions
checkers.precondition: nonnegative masses with positive total, particles and/or gas, at most 2e6 elements
checkers.rationale: Center of mass lies inside the bounding box of its sources.

checkers.invariant: `lambda = L sqrt(|E|)/(G M^{5/2})` has dimensions of 1 (checked symbolically on the returned unit)
checkers.precondition: finite result (an empty region gives 0/0); result evaluated
checkers.rationale: Spin parameter is dimensionless.

checkers.invariant: `sum_bins field = sum over data inside the binning bounds` (allowance: the absolute sum of points lying exactly on a bound, whose inclusion is a convention)
checkers.precondition: `deposition = ngp` (cloud-in-cell spills mass past the outer bins); `weight_field = None`, at most 2e6 data elements
checkers.rationale: An unweighted profile conserves the total of the profiled field.

checkers.invariant: `sum_b W_b = sum w` and `sum_b W_b m_b = sum w f` over data inside the bounds
checkers.precondition: `deposition = ngp`; nonnegative weights, at most 2e6 elements
checkers.rationale: A weighted profile conserves weight and weighted first moment.

checkers.alarm: difference `> allowance + n eps sum w f^2`
checkers.invariant: `sum_b W_b (s_b^2 + (m_b - M)^2) = sum w (f - M)^2`, `M` the global weighted mean
checkers.precondition: `deposition = ngp`; as PRF-002
checkers.rationale: A weighted profile satisfies the law of total variance.
